basic_details.job_title: GBPUAT Young Professional Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: G.B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar has released a notification for the recruitment of 1 Young Professional - II post under the National Mission on High Yielding Seeds (NMHYS) project in the Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding, College of Agriculture. Eligible candidates may apply offline by submitting their application by 22-10-2026, 04:00 PM.

how_to_apply: Fill out the prescribed application form provided in the official notification with complete details of the candidate, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach attested copies of all certificates, degrees, and testimonials supporting your qualifications.

Send the completed application to the Principal Investigator on his/her department address at the Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding, College of Agriculture, G.B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar - 263145.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 22-10-2026 by 04:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Master of Science degree in Agriculture (Genetics & Plant Breeding) along with work experience in pulses breeding. The category for the fellowship is Unreserved (Uttarakhand Female).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated emolument of 42000.00 per month. The engagement is for 6 months or the duration of the project, whichever is shorter, and may be extended as per project requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBPUAT Young Professional - II
content_sections.text: Fill out the prescribed application form provided in the official notification with complete details of the candidate, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach attested copies of all certificates, degrees, and testimonials supporting your qualifications. Send the completed application to the Principal Investigator on his/her department address at the Department of Genetics & Plant Breeding, College of Agriculture, G.B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar - 263145. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 22-10-2026 by 04:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. No separate interview letter will be issued, and no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The interview is scheduled for 23-10-2026 at 11:00 AM.
